text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali visited a poor country area near Tunis for the Eid feast day to see conditions there.
- Two Japanese volunteers arrived recently in Tunisia to help development programmes.
- Airline Tunis Air plans to renew its fleet with the purchase of nine aircraft.
- The National Solidarity Fund distributed hundreds of sheep to the poor nationwide for the traditional sacrifice of the Eid al-Adha.
